observation_indicators.observable_fil: May tatlong obserbasyong may kaugnay na resource at ebidensya; nagpapakita ng label, count at return routine; hindi ginagamit ang expired o maling bersyon.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Records three observations with resources and evidence, demonstrates a label-count-return routine and does not use expired items or incorrect versions.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nag-oorder sa hula o ginagamit ang expired o maling materyal para lang makatipid.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Orders from guesses or uses expired or incorrect material simply to save resources.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tatlong obserbasyong may kaugnay na resource at ebidensya; nagpapakita ng label, count at return routine; hindi ginagamit ang expired o maling bersyon. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.
levels.kaya_na_en: Records three observations with resources and evidence, demonstrates a label-count-return routine and does not use expired items or incorrect versions. Completes this without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nakikita ang waste ngunit walang ebidensya o routine owner; ipapunan ang audit row at ulitin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Identifies waste but gives no evidence or routine owner; complete the audit row and repeat.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nag-oorder sa hula o ginagamit ang expired o maling materyal para lang makatipid.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Orders from guesses or uses expired or incorrect material simply to save resources.
